scope: 308 current species-rank records. Earlier ITIS and Smithsonian checks apply only to their recorded matches/dates. The new blue-whale name/rank/common-name checks use MDD v2.5, WoRMS, GBIF and a Smithsonian educational account, not a collection redetermination. Other source/conflict limitations remain explicit.
method: Exact binomial lookup in the public ITIS service, full-record rank and English vernacular retrieval, and dereferencing stored GBIF accepted keys. ITIS is a Smithsonian-partnered system; an ITIS match is not a direct Smithsonian specimen determination. Common names vary by language and source. No match does not establish invalidity. An exact ITIS string match can be a non-accepted synonym; usage status and source conflicts are retained.

smithsonian.limitation: Smithsonian states that common-name association with specimen records is a work in progress. Direct collection verification is incomplete; no Smithsonian endorsement is claimed.

orcinus-orca.commonNameStatus: Institutional account common-name association; not a Smithsonian collection determination.

resolution.authority: NOAA/SMM concept with explicit MDD conflict
resolution.reason: Society for Marine Mammalogy/NOAA currently retain the eastern North Pacific resident and Bigg’s forms provisionally within Orcinus orca, whereas MDD v2.5 lists O. ater and O. rectipinnus as species. This single broad O. orca record is not a determination of the creator model’s ecotype and must not be added to separate split taxa without concept reconciliation. Global GBIF occurrence association is withheld.
